reviews.text: Our experience at Animal was consistent with previous visits. As always Dr David is great and always comforting.

I have had my dog since he was 3 months old, and now he is 11 years old. Animal Kind has been his only veterinarian, and I am very satisfied with them. A few years ago, the front desk staff seemed a bit uneasy, but it seems things have changed, and overall the experience has been fine. I have taken my dog there for his annual checkup, vaccination update, dental cleaning, microchip insertion- everything, and the vets have always been great, super patient, and thoughtful.
Always a great experience.

Dr. Werner is an incredibly intelligent, compassionate and thorough vet. My dog is very well cared for here by the whole team. I would recommend Animal Kind to all my friends and family.  Thanks Dr. Werner!

My dog Rusty and I were well treated by the Dr., the tech.,
and personnel at the clinic.
Dr. Easterling was very knowledgeable about an international travel with pet and very helpful.
Amazing animal hospital / our veterinarian Dr. Sara Witherell is fantastic. Could not recommend this place more warmly. A+++

My puppy has handling reactivity. It's a significant challenge. I have found that the vets and vet techs treat me and my puppy with care. They are helping us figure out how to best manage this. Also, I must add that the folks behind the reception desk are the best. All in all, I'm impressed with Animal Kind and look forward to many more visits.

Dr Witherell treated both of my cats and cared for them until the end. She's knowledgeable, compassionate, and thoughtful. She's also extremely patient, answering my many questions. I've been going to Animal Kind for sixteen years and I can't recommend Dr. Withrell highly enough. She's just wonderful and I feel grateful that my cats had her.

we have loved our experiences at Animal Kind, and then came the time for the $600+ ultrasound for our cat, and, I have to say, I feel it was worth it. The doctor spent so much time with me explaining the images, what was happening, what our options were, allowed me time to take notes and ask questions, and was very patient when I asked more and more. It's hard to cough up that money when your pet is in need, but I felt it was worth it. Thank you.
They have treated our cats since the 90s, and their staff is excellent and they have my full support.
Very caring staff and well maintained office.  Also very popular in the neighborhood!
Really appreciate all the care from this great team. Thank you!

Wonderful and caring experience. Took my 13 year old cat in for an annual exam after avoiding the vet for a couple years. The treatment and communication was thoughtful and gentle and my cat was treated beautifully. Highly recommend
Animal Kind has been the veterinary center where I take my cats for care since 1995.  Staff is friendly, caring and professional.
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We are glad to hear that you had a positive experience at Animal Kind Veterinary Hospital.
We're utterly delighted to hear about your positive experience at Animal Kind Veterinary Hospital. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us.
We are ecstatic to hear about your positive experience at Animal Kind Veterinary Hospital. Thank you for your feedback!
Love Dr. David. Great visit - healing dog

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I can't say enough wonderful things about this veterinary clinic! I've been bringing all three of my dogs here, and every visit has been a great experience. Dr. Easterling is absolutely amazing, she is compassionate, knowledgeable, and truly takes the time to listen to all of my concerns. She always explains everything clearly and makes sure my dogs receive the best possible care.

The entire team is friendly, professional, and genuinely cares about every pet that walks through the door. I always feel welcomed, and I know my dogs are in the best hands. Thank you for everything you do! I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a veterinarian they can truly trust.

I am so happy my cat received the care she needed and the medication to help her recover. The veterinary team took the time to clearly explain what was going to be done for her and thoroughly reviewed how to give each medication. I especially appreciated that the syringes were prepared with a red line showing the exact dosage, which made giving her medication at home much less stressful. Thank you for your kindness, professionalism, and excellent care of my cat.

Could not recommend Animal Kind vet more. Their process for getting an appt is seamless, the vets are very knowledgable and kind. They take their time to answer all questions and concerns. Their follow up is also great. Our 10-month-old puppy has been there several times and all visits have been positive. Thank you!

I had a great experience at Animal Kind. Dr. David is great. Very caring and gentle with my pets. I trust her 100% with my pets.

One of the best Vet Offices in Brooklyn. All out cats love it there.    Cleo our shy girl felt comfy with the vets and techs. The doctors are thorough and truly care about  our animals. Hazel just got fixed. They were amazing with her. she is doing well and have calmed down. Our Charlie becomes the Goodest boy in their office.  Animal kind has been with us through good and bad times with our cats and took care of our Sunny until he passed a few months ago. I recommend them to everyone. Thank you for taking good care of our babies.
